spans.s:
mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Incapable of distress or pain.
2 Unfit to be pained or distressed.
E.
अ neg. क्लेद्य to be pained.

m. (-मः)
Absence of weariness or fatigue.
E.
अ priv. and क्लम fatigue.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Unwearied.
E.
अ neg. and क्लान्त wearied.

mfn. (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Unvexed, not distressed or annoyed.
2 Unwearied, indefatigable.
E.
अ neg. क्लिष्ट wearied.

m. (-शः)
Absence of weariness or vexation.
E.
अ neg. क्लेश distress.
